DATED 06.09.2021 FOR THE OFFENCE WHICH IS MADE U/S 498(A) OF IPC ON THE FILE OF V ADDL.C.M.M., BENGALURU.

THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

The petitioner is before this Court calling in question registration of crime in Cr.No.210/2021 registered on 06.09.2021.
2.

During pendency of the petition, the parties to the lis submit that police have filed charge sheet and the matter is NC: 2023:KHC:20469 pending before the V Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bangalore, in CC No.2751/2022.

The parties to the lis were also before the Family Court viz., IV Additional Principal Judge Family Court, Bengaluru, in MC No.5314/2021, before whom the parties have settled the dispute amongst themselves by drawing up certain conditions of such settlement.

Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Bangalore.

entities.text: V Addl. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Bangalore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The copies of the photo ID proofs of the petitioner and 2nd respondent are attached herewith for the kind perusal of the Hon'ble Court."

In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties and the offence being one punishable under Section 498A of the IPC, I deem it appropriate to accept the application seeking compounding of offences and to terminate the proceedings against the petitioner.

Since the charge sheet is NC:
2023:KHC:20469 filed during the pendency of these proceedings and the matter has been settled,
the following:
ORDER a) Criminal petition stands disposed of.
b) The proceedings in CC No.2751/2022 registered in Annapoorneshwari Nagara Police Station, Bengaluru for the offences punishable under Section 498(A) of IPC pending on the file of V Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Bangalore,
stands quashed against the petitioner.
